PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  June 27, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, June 27, 2019,
at 2:00 pm in the Council Chambers, 9th Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk 2:17
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Lt. David Salcedo, Police Department
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
June 13, 2019 and Special Meeting on June 17, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Rick Miller DBA Inglewood Park Cemetery to host a Jazz Concert – Tribute
  Concert to Etta James at 720 E. Florence Avenue, June 30, 2019, from
  2:00 p.m. – 4:00 p.m. subject to Inglewood Park Cemetery to provide
  adequate security to maintain and monitor crowd control; Any person
  directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective vests; IPD
  to provide extra patrol as time permits, Watch Commander will be notified;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at
  the end of the event; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site; and Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00275684)

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Larren Morales DBA L.A. Care Health Plan to host a Back to School Health
  Fair at 3111 W. Century Blvd., Ste. 100, July 13, 2019, from 10 a.m. to 2:00
  p.m., approval for one day event within commercial parking lot; applicant
  must notify all other tenants in building and applicant responsible for crowd
  control and event clean up; must hire & deploy 2 uniformed / licensed
 Permits & License Committee  June 27, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 5

  security guards for crowd management and safety (security co. must be
  permitted to work in Inglewood); security guards and/or anyone directing
  traffic in parking lot shall wear reflective vest(s) to manage the parking lot;
  the area of the parking lot where attendees are expected to gather shall be
  clear of motor vehicles and coned off /barricaded to keep vehicles out of
  where pedestrians will be;. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00275736)

Item #3  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Ari Ruiz DBA Assembly Member Autumn Burke to host a Mother’s in
  Charge Community Forum and Fair at Inglewood City Hall – South Open
  Grass Area, July 27, 2019, from 10:00 a.m. from 1:00 p.m., approval of a
  one day event; will be staffed with 1 uniformed Inglewood police officers
  and 1 police car (0900-1400 hrs); maintain site at all times, ensuring site
  is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00275876)

Item #4:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Cesar Lucero DBA MC Fuente De Vida Inc. to host a Hope Festival at
  10530 S. Prairie Ave., July 27, 2019, from 10:00 a.m. from 5:00 p.m.
  approval of a one day event; parking lot to be completely closed to
  vehicular traffic; applicant must hire/have 4 uniformed licensed security
  guards for public safety; those directing traffic shall have reflective vests for
  safety reasons; no directing of traffic on public streets; no alcoholic
  beverages permitted at this event; adhere to all local, state and federal
  laws. IPD Watch Commander will be notified of event and will provide extra
  patrol as needed and time permitting. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity
  No. 00275506)

Business License Request(s):

Item #5:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Juan F. Palos DBA Du Moy Kennels to operate a kennel at 1115
  W. Hillcrest Blvd. Approved subject to current applicable state licensing on
  all employees; maintain a clean / sanitized facility at all times to ensure the
  health & safety of all animals being serviced or housed at the
  establishment; facility is subject to inspection by any police, code
  enforcement or animal control officer at any time (day or night). NO
  improper disposal of waste products of any kind. Adhere to all local, state
  and federal laws. Adhere to all “Facility and Maintenance Standards
  provided with business license. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No.
  00275720)

Item #6:  A motion was moved and seconded to HOLDOVER for further investigation
  for Naleisha Webb DBA Nay’s Tacos Inc. to operate a catering truck.
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00275701)
 Permits & License Committee  June 27, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

Item #7:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Shanita Nicolas & Amanda-June Thomas DBA Sip & Sonder to
  operate a café-bar with live entertainment at 108 S. Market Street. Approval
  for live entertainment within existing cafe in H-C zone. Must comply with all
  conditions of approval for SP-2019-005.; ALL patrons / employees shall
  have valid identification to be inside and remain as an employee or paying
  customer at the location (Bar area only). **Valid ID shall be available upon
  request to any law enforcement or code enforcement officer(s); shall post
  NO LOITERING / PANHANDLING SIGNS in front / outside of the business
  as well; applicant or his / her designee are subject to random permit &
  license / establishment inspections at ANYTIME of the day or night, by any
  police or code enforcement officer(s), including California Department of
  Alcohol Beverage Control Investigators; adhering to the regulations set
  forth by the State of California Alcohol Beverage Control; Adhere to all
  local, state and federal laws; No use/consumption/sales of cannabis or
  cannabis products (edibles) and/or any illegal narcotics; APPLICANT AND
  EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL,
  AND/OR ACTIVITY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE
  OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E.
  CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Failure to comply
  with any of the aforementioned may result in the revocation of your
  business license and any future business license application requests
  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00275716)

Item #8:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Lisa Jackson DBA 3D Haircare Salon to operate a hair salon at
  1504 ½ Centinela Avenue, subject to payment of annual business license
  and tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain valid and current
  Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology;
  Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within
  the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board
  of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and
  Manicurists operating within the establishment is required to register and
  file business tax with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and
  current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; shall apply/submit application
  for permit for other social/party events. Consumption of alcoholic
  beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted
  on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted;
  Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT
  AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL,
  AND/OR ACTIVTY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE
  OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E.
 Permits & License Committee  June 27, 2019
Minutes  Page 4 of 5

  CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Failure to comply
  with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application request. Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00275655)

Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):

Item #9:  Anil Ali DBA 7-Eleven Store 26166D to operate as a tobacco retailer at
  1117 W. Manchester Blvd, subject to sales of single cigarettes is strictly
  prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to
  minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons purchasing tobacco or
  any related tobacco products shall have valid identification on their person
  at all times to enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use,
  including hookah products; “NO LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,”
  and “NO PANHANDLING” signage must be posted outside of the business;
  sales of marijuana and cannabis products, narcotics and narcotics
  paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used to ingest other narcotics such as
  base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine, including glass cylindrical tube
  and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke and/or ingest narcotics; sales of
  Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or display of any type of weapons, i.e.,
  clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited;
  Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their
  designees is subject to random Permits & Licensing establishment
  inspections at any time of the day or night by any Police and Code
  Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is to enforce business
  establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of Inglewood
  and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes, live bands/music,
  disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business owner(s) is required
  to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all applicable IMC rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00274931)

Business License Renewal Request(s):

Item #10:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard
  business recommendation applicable to each business type. Motion
  carried unanimously.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity No.

  1  Value Rental Car Inc.  Auto Rent/Lease  00249706
  2  Nadine's Barber Shop  Hair/Nail Salon  00249757
  3  Kevin Johnson  Parking Lot  00249971
 Permits & License Committee  June 27, 2019

Item #11:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of tobacco retailer businesses renewals with standard
  recommendations. Motion carried unanimously.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity
  No.
  1  A&E Fuels Inc. DBA ACE Fuels  Convenience Store  00250310

  2  Vons Co. Inc. #2502  Grocery Store  00250319

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:25 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
